left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Histologically  [OR] or cytologically confirmed non-small cell lung cancer
-  The ECOG score of performance status is 0-1

right.raw_text: -  Locally advanced  [OR] or recurrent metastatic NSCLC that has never received systemic treatment

left.raw_text: 1 criteria, there is at least 1 measurable lesion that has not been previously irradiated

right.raw_text: -  Prior to enrollment, a central laboratory testing report has confirmed that the tumor has one of two common EGFR mutations positive that are sensitive to EGFR-TKI therapy, accompanied with or not accompanied with other EGFR mutation, with the exception of exon 20 insertion

left.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Previously received systemic treatment for locally advanced  [OR] or recurrent metastatic cancer

right.raw_text: -  Previous interstitial lung disease, [OR]  drug-induced interstitial lung disease, [OR]  radiation pneumonia requiring hormonal therapy, [OR]  or any clinically proven active interstitial lung disease

left.raw_text: -  Known active infections such as hepatitis B, [OR]  hepatitis C, [OR]  and human immunodeficiency virus
-  Local radiation therapy is carried out within 1 week; more than 30% bone marrow radiation therapy  [OR] or extensive radiation therapy is performed within 4 weeks

right.raw_text: -  ≤ 4 weeks from major surgery  [OR] or ≤ 2 weeks from minor surgery
